hypothesis: All 4489 reported ELN input components have amounts, omitted by the old model. Unit-safe pre-reaction stoichiometry/concentration and molecule-before-role pooling may improve scaffold-disjoint yield MAE; robust Huber loss may better match the MAE objective.
feature_allowlist: Only existing molecular inputs/roles, temperature setpoint, reported input moles/volumes and is_limiting. No outcomes, product graphs, yield/analysis fields, notes, times, source IDs or procedure text enter predictors.
units: Convert mol/mmol/umol/nmol to moles and L/mL/uL/nL to liters. Unknown units and mass-only amounts are missing, not inferred. Reject negative/nonfinite values. Reference is smallest positive explicitly limiting reactant moles, else smallest positive reactant moles.
component_pooling: GINE on disjoint molecular graphs, mean atoms into components, then mean component embeddings by reaction role; explicit component counts retained.
split: Preserve all 740 existing valid rows and source groups; original 610-row development/130-row historically observed ELN test. Three same principal-scaffold-disjoint development folds as old optimize. Assert source IDs/groups/signatures unchanged.
gnn_adoption: New architecture must improve mean 3-fold validation MAE by at least 0.5 percentage points and beat legacy on >=2/3 folds; otherwise retain legacy procedure. Among eligible choose lowest mean MAE, ties prefer declared order. Refit median best epoch count.
baselines: Per-fold training median; original role fingerprint RandomForest200 leaf1/3/8; quantities-augmented role fingerprints with RandomForest400 or ExtraTrees400 leaf1/3/8. Tree selection is validation only and separately reported.
evaluation: Training command performs development validation only. Freeze selection before explicit evaluation/refit and one descriptive already-observed ELN test comparison. 50688-row HTE source remains untouched for label-based adaptation/selection; evaluate deterministic identifier-hash sample2048 once after final model freeze, excluding exact ELN input clones.
disclosure: ELN test and earlier aggregate results already observed. No fresh ELN generalization claim. HTE source uses assay yields and narrow two-amine/four-aryl design, so cross-source results do not establish broad chemistry or comparable isolated-yield accuracy.
reporting: Root train.py, explicit evaluation_scripts, Report.md baseline-versus-selected table, module implementations, EDA-only notebooks, logs/aggregate configs committed. Raw/processed data, row predictions, full queue records, and weights ignored.
